text:
marco: Quick sync — we need to lock QBR slots for the next cycle. Proposal: 'slot-stacking' for top SI partners so they get contiguous QBR time for co-presentations + joint announcements. Also proposing a small MDF escrow to reserve effort. Thoughts? :calendar: :moneybag:
alyssa: Slot-stacking sounds useful for demo flow. EDF: how big are we thinking for MDF escrow? we shouldn't overcommit runway. $5k-$10k per slot maybe, scaled by tier.
jing: Contiguous slots are great. We should gate MDF release with a scorecard. Suggest gating metrics: last-12mo pipeline influence + marketplace activations + enablement completion.
samir: Can we include enablement hours as part of the escrow (i.e., partner commits to 8 hrs enablement delivered or funds return)? Also drafted a quick scoring formula that might work:
```
score = round(0.4 * rev_impact + 0.3 * marketplace_refs + 0.3 * enablement_points)
```
We can set minimum score threshold to qualify for full MDF release.
marco: I sketched a rubric doc with tier multipliers and slot mapping: https://redwood.app/internal/partners/qbr-slot-rubric — uploaded it to the drive.
ops-bot: File uploaded to /drive/partners/qbr_slot_rubric_v1.xlsx (owner: marco)
alyssa: MDF cadence idea: 50% upfront to reserve slot, 50% after partner delivers post-QBR report and hits score >= threshold. If score below threshold, remaining 50% returns to MDF pool. Helps limit wasted spend.
jing: What should the threshold be? 60? 65? Also we should cap total MDF per partner per quarter to avoid concentration.
samir: Recommend threshold = 65, cap = $20k/partner/quarter. Tie slot counts to tier: platinum = up to 3 stacked slots, gold = 2, silver = 1. That keeps predictability.
marco: Sounds reasonable. Action items: alyssa -> model MDF runway & mid-quarter impact; samir -> update scorecard calc and add retrieval rules; jing -> draft stacked-slot QBR agenda template (partner-led demo + customer panel + 15m joint roadmap). I'll calendar a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize.
alyssa: On it. FYI marketplace activation numbers might shift weights in the formula; I'll pull last 4 quarters and share a quick sensitivity table. pinging finance separately for budget runway.
jing: I'll include a sample agenda and a short facilitation guide so ops can run stacked slots smoothly.
samir: If no objections by EOD I'll stage this as a proposal in the partner ops playbook and tag partner PMs for review.
marco: :thumbsup: thanks folks. ops-bot: reminder set for 10:00 AM tomorrow — "QBR slot-stacking sync"
marco: closing note — let's also surface this at next partner council so SIs see the new process before we publish the booking flow.
